content.comment_body: Is anyone else experiencing this? While attempting to use a counter in [product_name] V8, I noticed there's no way to reference it in the maths function. When I create a simple program in [product_name] V7.1, then save and open it in V8, the counter shows up, but it's greyed out and cannot be selected. I'm currently using Windows 7.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a limitation in [product_name] V8, where counters cannot be directly referenced in maths functions. This feature was available, or at least visible, when importing programs from [product_name] V7.1. Counters appear greyed out after migration, suggesting restricted integration in the newer version, which hampers workflow and continuity of features between versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates uninterrupted functionality when working with counters in maths functions with newer software releases, matching the capability of previous versions.
